concepts.title: What clustering is
concepts.outcome: Explain what cluster analysis does, when it is used, and what a cluster ID gives you.

keyPoints.text: Cluster analysis is an exploratory tool for dividing a multivariate dataset into natural groups, to see whether groups that were never defined in advance exist; a marketing team might sort customers into segments this way.

keyPoints.text: Cluster analysis suits data thought to come from an unknown number of distinct sub-populations with no prior definition; the aim is to describe those sub-populations from the observed data.
